name: New Things
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God calls His people to forget the former things and embrace the new work He is doing, as seen in Isaiah where God promises to make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. This newness reflects God's sovereign plan to bring peace and hope, assuring His people of an expected future. Ultimately, Revelation affirms that God Himself makes all things new, underscoring the faithfulness and truth of His transformative power in the life of the believer.
